proof_body:
by
  intro f g U c hU hc hcU hf hg hd z hz
  have hd' : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => f z - g z) U := hf.sub hg
  have h0 : Set.EqOn (deriv (fun z => f z - g z)) 0 U := by
    intro x hx
    have hfx := hf.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)
    have hgx := hg.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)
    rw [deriv_fun_sub hfx hgx, hd x hx]; simp
  exact hU.is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero hc hd' h0 hz hcU
target_source: ∀ (f g : ℂ → ℂ) (U : Set ℂ) (c : ℂ), IsOpen U → IsPreconnected U → c ∈ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U → (∀ z ∈ U, deriv f z = deriv g z) → ∀ z ∈ U, f z - g z = f c - g c
